en.q: What documents are required to rent a bike?
en.a:
You'll need:
- Valid Driving License
- Government-issued ID
- Booking Confirmation

en.q: What documents do foreigners need to rent a bike?
en.a: You need a passport, an international driving permit, and a visa copy.

en.q: Can I rent a bike with an international license?
en.a: Yes, valid international driving licenses are accepted.

en.q: What is the minimum age to rent a self-drive bike?
en.a: You must be at least 18 years old with a valid driving license.

en.q: How do I book a bike on WavyGo?
en.a: Open the WavyGo app or website, pick your city and dates, choose a bike, and confirm payment.

en.q: Can I cancel or reschedule my booking?
en.a: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule from the My Bookings section up to 2 hours before pickup.

en.q: How do fuel costs compare with ride-sharing fares?
en.a: Self-drive rentals are usually more cost effective than ride-sharing for trips longer than a few hours.
Yes, a refundable security deposit is collected at pickup and released after the bike is returned undamaged.
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

en.q: What are the penalties for traffic violations during rental?
en.a: You are responsible for any traffic penalties incurred during your rental period.

en.q: What are the best transport options for tourists and locals?
en.a: Self-drive rentals, cabs, metro, and buses are all common options depending on distance and budget.

en.q: What happens if the bike breaks down during my rental?
en.a: Contact our support line immediately. We'll arrange a replacement bike or roadside assistance.

en.q: How do I contact WavyGo support?
en.a: Email support@wavygo.in or call our support line listed in the app.

hi.q: Bike kiraye par lene ke liye kaunse dastavez chahiye?
hi.a:
Aapko chahiye:
- Valid Driving License
- Sarkari ID
- Booking Confirmation

hi.q: Videshi nagrikon ke liye kaunse dastavez chahiye?
hi.a: Aapko passport, international driving permit, aur visa copy chahiye.

hi.q: Kya main international license se bike kiraye par le sakta hoon?
hi.a: Haan, valid international driving license swikar kiya jata hai.

hi.q: Self-drive bike kiraye par lene ke liye minimum age kya hai?
hi.a: Aapki umar kam se kam 18 saal honi chahiye aur valid driving license hona chahiye.

hi.q: WavyGo par bike kaise book karein?
hi.a: WavyGo app ya website kholein, apna shahar aur tareekh chunein, bike chunein, aur payment confirm karein.

hi.q: Kya main apni booking cancel ya reschedule kar sakta hoon?
hi.a: Haan, aap pickup se 2 ghante pehle tak My Bookings section se cancel ya reschedule kar sakte hain.

hi.q: Fuel cost ride-sharing fare se kaise compare hota hai?
hi.a: Lambi trip ke liye self-drive rental aksar zyada cost effective hota hai.
Haan, ek refundable security deposit pickup ke waqt liya jata hai aur bike sahi salamat wapas aane par release hota hai.

hi.q: Refund aane mein kitna time lagta hai?
hi.a: Refund 5-7 business dino mein aapke original payment method mein process ho jata hai.

hi.q: Rental ke dauran traffic violation ke liye kya penalty hai?
hi.a: Rental period ke dauran hui kisi bhi traffic penalty ke aap zimmedar honge.

hi.q: Tourists aur locals ke liye best transport options kya hain?
hi.a: Self-drive rental, cab, metro, aur bus - ye sab common options hain, distance aur budget ke hisaab se.

hi.q: Agar rental ke dauran bike kharab ho jaye to kya karein?
hi.a: Turant hamari support line par sampark karein. Hum replacement bike ya roadside assistance arrange karenge.

hi.q: WavyGo support se kaise sampark karein?
hi.a: support@wavygo.in par email karein ya app mein diye gaye support number par call karein.
